paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -2.96% on average, with DAX strongest (-1.15%) and Dow Jones weakest (-4.36%). Brent crude changed -4.40% to 88.68. Gold changed -6.82% to 3,727.8. Bitcoin changed -8.85% to 62,210.25. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.066%, a relative move of +1.36%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-17.18%) and BHP (-14.29%) moved the most.
